implementation.legacy_compatibility: All five memory_* tools and accepted schemas remain present and unchanged.
implementation.project_identity: A restrictive atomic registry stores UUID identity, repository identity, and up to 32 canonical path aliases.
implementation.storage: Each project owns Projects/<uuid>/memory.sqlite3 with WAL, foreign keys, busy timeout, typed bindings, transactions, schema version 1, and integrity checks.
implementation.search: Deterministic lexical ranking, kind/tag/session filters, opaque cursors, row limits, and encoded-byte response limits are enforced.
implementation.redaction: Credential patterns are redacted before persistence and private-key material is rejected.
implementation.recovery: Unsupported future versions preserve the database unchanged; corruption preserves a recovery artifact; exports are checksummed; lock failures are typed and transactional.
implementation.transport: The stdio executable passed initialize, tools/list, schemas, typed errors, cancellation, pagination, redaction, status, and restart durability.
